description: Single-airframe campus display on the Université de Kinshasa grounds at Mbanza-Lemba, beside the Route de Matadi. Recorded by only one source, which lists it as an ex-Italian Air Force F-86E(M), serial MM19542, construction number 442. That identity is left out of the tail number field deliberately: it is uncorroborated, no F-86 in central Africa appears on the Wikipedia surviving-Sabres list, no Italian or Congolese source found accounts for an ex-Italian Sabre reaching Kinshasa, and painted markings are not identity. The same source codes the airframe derelict, and its compiler answered a contributor's claim of preservation by saying the current condition is hard to describe as anything but derelict - a judgement about condition, not about intent. Recorded here because a Sabre does not arrive on a university campus by accident and the position is an institutional lawn rather than a scrap line. Esri WorldView-2 imagery of 15 February 2025 shows a pale, partly tree-shaded cluster of airframe-sized objects at the recorded position, consistent with but not proof of an F-86.
